name: NMS-SYS-TEMPERATURE-MIB.mib
text:
NMS-SYS-TEMPERATURE-MIB DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN

	IMPORTS
		sys		
			FROM NMS-SYS-MIB		
		Integer32, OBJECT-TYPE, MODULE-IDENTITY		
			FROM SNMPv2-SMI;


	-- xx.2.1
	dummyTemperatureModule MODULE-IDENTITY 
		LAST-UPDATED "202511131307Z"
		ORGANIZATION 
			"NYNEX satellite OHG / fiberONE"
		CONTACT-INFO 
			"noc@fiberone.de"
		DESCRIPTION 
				"Define system private MIB nodes for NMS."
		REVISION  "202511131307Z"		-- October 16, 2020 at 11:42 GMT
		DESCRIPTION 
			"init"
		::= { sys 999 }	


	temperatureTable OBJECT-TYPE
		SYNTAX SEQUENCE OF TemperatureEntry
		MAX-ACCESS not-accessible
		STATUS current
		DESCRIPTION
			"Table containing all temperature readings."
		::= { sys 4 }

	temperatureEntry OBJECT-TYPE
		SYNTAX TemperatureEntry
		MAX-ACCESS not-accessible
		STATUS current
		DESCRIPTION
			"temperature probe data"
		INDEX { temperatureIndex }
		::= { temperatureTable 1 }

	temperatureIndex OBJECT-TYPE
		SYNTAX Integer32 (1..2147483647)
		MAX-ACCESS not-accessible
		STATUS current
		DESCRIPTION
			"Temperature probe index"
		::= { temperatureEntry 1 }

	temperatureValue OBJECT-TYPE
		SYNTAX Integer32
		MAX-ACCESS read-only
		STATUS current
		DESCRIPTION
			"Temperature in celsius"
		::= { temperatureEntry 2 }	

	TemperatureEntry ::=
		SEQUENCE { 
			temperatureIndex Integer32,
			temperatureValue Integer32
		 }


END
